rulings.Case Title: IN THE MATTER OF THE GAETANO (THOMAS) IVELI REVOCABLE TRUST, DATED 12/9/02
rulings.Calendar Matter: Notice Of Motion And Motion To (1) Deem Requests For Admission Admitted; 2) Compel Responses To Interrogatories And 3) Compel Responses To Requests For Production Of Documents; Request For Monetary Sanctions [And For Further Relief]
rulings.Rulings: This tentative ruling is issued by Judge Russell S. Roeca. Before the court is Petitioners' Motion To: (1) Deem Requests For Admission Admitted; (2) Compel Responses To Interrogatories; and (3) Compel Responses To Requests For Production Of Documents; Request For Monetary Sanctions ("Motion"). The Motion is GRANTED. As of the time this tentative ruling is posted, there is no showing on the record before the court that Code-compliant responses to the propounded discovery at issue have been served. Pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure section 2033.280, Petitioners' First Set for Requests for Admission to Jon Vigna, Nos. 1 through 41, are DEEMED ADMITTED. Pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure section 2030.290, Respondent Jon Vigna is ORDERED to serve verified responses without objection to Petitioners' First Set of Special Interrogatories, Nos. 1 through 50, within ten (10) days of entry of this Order. Pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure section 2030.290, Respondent Jon Vigna is ORDERED to serve verified responses without objection to Petitioners' Form Interrogatories - General, Set One, within ten (10) days of entry of this Order. Pursuant to Code of Civil procedure section 2031.300, Respondent Jon Vigna is ORDERED to serve verified responses without objection, and to produce all responsive documents, in connection with Petitioners' First Request for Production of Documents, Nos. 1 through 20, within ten (10) days of entry of this Order. Petitioners' request for sanctions is GRANTED. Monetary sanctions are awarded pursuant to Code of Civil Procedure sections 2030.300(d), 2033.280(c), 2030.290(c), 2031.300(c), 2023.010(d), and 2023.010(h), in the amount of the reasonable expenses, including attorney's fees, incurred by Petitioners in successfully making this Motion. Respondent Jon Vigna is ordered to pay Petitioners sanctions in the amount of nine thousand five hundred ($9,500), within ten (10) days of entry of this order. Any party wishing to contest this tentative ruling by appearing at the scheduled hearing must do so advise other parties and the courtroom clerk (415-551-3702) no later than 4:00 p.m. on the day before the hearing. To appear by Zoom, go to zoom.us and click "Join Meeting." Enter Meeting ID number 1602254765 and passcode 514879. To appear telephonically through Zoom, call 1-669-900-6833 and follow the prompts. Enter Meeting ID number 1602254765# and passcode 514879#. Parties appearing via Zoom should use their full names in the "Your Name" section. Counsel and parties may appear by audio-only telephone through CourtCall by calling CourtCall at 1-888-882-6878 and obtaining an appearance access code for the hearing's scheduled date and time in Department 204.
